abilities.name: Stellar Rend
_curatorNotes: No charge.go in gcsim character dir — chargeFrames not available. Claymore spinning charged attack is not implemented in gcsim for this character.

Gaming has three distinct plunge types in gcsim: (1) lowPlungeFrames (Xianyun-assisted, used for plungeFrames here), (2) highPlungeFrames (not represented per recipe), (3) specialPlungeFrames (Charmed Cloudstrider, triggered when LastAction=Skill). specialPlungeFrames values for reviewer: swap=69, N=52, E=52, Q=52, D=32 — this is Gaming's primary DPS plunge and is not representable via standard plungeFrames/plungeVariants without schema extension. Reviewer to decide representation strategy; may require Tier B reclassification.

abilities.name: Bestial Ascent
_curatorNotes: Skill launches Gaming airborne; in gcsim the earliest cancel keys are ActionLowPlunge=23 and ActionHighPlunge=23 (redirected to specialPlunge when LastAction=Skill). These are non-standard frame keys not representable in the JSON FrameMap. Standard keys N, Q, D are not explicitly set (default to AnimationLength=64) and are omitted. The primary follow-up is the special plunge (Charmed Cloudstrider) at frame 23; see normal ability _curatorNotes for specialPlungeFrames values. Reviewer to determine how to represent E→P timing in the planner.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/rounds/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim gaming/skill.go:26-33 sets the CD only; damage is the follow-up plunge.
abilities.description:
Pounces forward using the Wushou arts, leaping high into the air after coming into contact with a target or surface.
After Gaming has used Bestial Ascent to rise into the air, if he immediately uses a Plunging Attack, he will use the especially powerful Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider instead.

Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider
The DMG from Plunging Attacks caused by Bestial Ascent is converted to Pyro DMG that cannot be overridden by other elemental infusions. Upon landing, Gaming will consume a fixed amount of HP. Gaming's HP cannot be reduced below 10% by this method.
Charmed Cloudstrider DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.

abilities.name: Suanni's Gilded Dance
_curatorNotes: Behavior changed from 'stance' to 'instant': Wushou Stance does not replace Gaming's normals or charged attacks — it is a 12s self-status (burstKey) enabling Man Chai respawning on each successful Charmed Cloudstrider or forward pounce with >50% HP. Canceled on swap-off (gcsim onExitField). Man Chai spawns at burstHitmark+1=61f with variable walkback duration (gcsim manChaiWalkBack default=100f, user-controlled via man_chai_delay param) and re-spawns throughout the 12s window. summons[] not authored due to variable/repeating nature — reviewer to decide representation for Wushou Stance window and Man Chai.

↻ REWORKED 2026-09-17 (T1.5): the inherited `manual` `buff hp% 50` (wrong type, wrong number, unreachable) is now the heal gcsim applies — burst.go Player.Heal HealTypePercent Src 0.3 on Gaming at burstStart (36f): 30% Max HP. The 12s Wushou Stance window and Man Chai stay unauthored (see the note above).

frames re-transcribed (2026-09-17, T1.5): gcsim burstFrames = InitAbilSlice(77) — `anim` 66 → 77 (66 is its Dash override, which had no key and is now D 66). Q→C / Q→Q / Q→P and the human-timing full-animation reading were 11f short.
abilities.description:
Gaming enters Wushou Stance, briefly applying Pyro to him, recovering a fixed amount of HP, and summons his companion, the Suanni Man Chai, to smash into his target, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
After bashing its target, Man Chai will roll to a nearby location before moving towards Gaming. When it links up with Gaming, Man Chai will leave the field and reset the CD for Gaming's Elemental Skill, Bestial Ascent.
While Wushou Stance is active, his resistance to interruption is increased, and when Gaming lands with Charmed Cloudstrider attack or completes the forward pounce attack from Bestial Ascent with over 50% HP, he will summon Man Chai again.
Each Gaming can only have 1 Man Chai on the field simultaneously.
This effect will be canceled once Gaming leaves the field.

passives.name: Dance of Amity
_curatorNotes: Periodic self-heal: 1.5% MaxHP (gcsim: Src=0.015, HealTypePercent) every 0.2s (12f) for 0.8s (4 ticks), 0.8s ICD between proc windows; triggered by Charmed Cloudstrider plunge after E. gcsim: makeA1CB() callback → AddStatus(a1Key, 0.8*60) + QueueCharTask(a1Heal, 0.2*60) chain. Fixed 2026-07-16 (surfaced by audit-data-outliers): was mis-modeled as an hp% stat buff, now type 'heal' (manual trigger retained for conservatism — could refine to onHit/plunge + procCooldown 0.8).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: Dance of Amity — effects[0] (heal self, 1.5% hp) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `internal/characters/gaming/asc.go:14-29` (`makeA1CB`) is attached to the Charmed Cloudstrider plunge's `QueueAttack` (`plunge.go:225`); it adds an 0.8s `a1Key` status and starts the `a1Heal` chain (`asc.go:31-44`), which heals `Src: 0.015` `HealTypePercent` on Gaming himself and re-queues every 12f while the status holds. the cadence the schema cannot say — 1.5% Max HP per tick, every 0.2s (12f), four ticks per window, each window gated by the 0.8s `a1Key` status — following the Dori-burst / Escoffier "Rehab Diet" precedent (single effect, `duration` = the full window, `scaling` = the PER-TICK value, cadence in the note). Also retain that the `a1Key` status IS both the window and the re-proc gate, so `duration` and `procCooldown` are deliberately the same number. ⚠️ Scoped in game to Charmed Cloudstrider, which our data does not model as a distinct ability — `plungeFrames` on `gaming__normal__stellar_rend` is gcsim's Xianyun-assisted high plunge, and a plunge hit carries `abilityName: activeNormal?.name` (`run.ts:2184`), i.e. "Stellar Rend" for both, so `filter.abilityName` cannot separate them. In practice the over-claim is near zero: gcsim refuses Gaming a low/high plunge unless `AirborneXianyun` (`plunge.go:82-87`, `135-141`) and redirects to the special plunge whenever `LastAction == Skill`, so a `P` token that is NOT Charmed Cloudstrider only exists in a Xianyun team. ⚠️ Heal draws no planner pixel; the gain is the Team Builder self-heal facet, badge and coverage row that `manual` was suppressing.

passives.name: Air of Prosperity
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — A4 has two HP-conditional branches implemented as permanent modifiers: (1) <50% HP: incoming healing bonus +20% (stat: incomingHealingBonus); (2) ≥50% HP: Charmed Cloudstrider DMG +20% (stat: plungeFlatDmg or similar — gcsim uses DmgP on the specific attack). constellations.name: Bringer of Blessing
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger on heal effect — fires when Man Chai walks back to Gaming and links up (custom delayed-task event, not standard onHit/onCast/onReaction). gcsim: queueManChai() in burst.go adds a delayed task at manChaiWalkBack frames → c1() heal call. Trigger type does not map cleanly to a schema trigger. Reviewer to determine representation. Heal: 15% MaxHP (gcsim: HealTypePercent, Src=0.15).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 Bringer of Blessing — effects[0] (heal self, 15% hp) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `internal/characters/gaming/burst.go:86-101` (`queueManChai`) — the burst queues it at `burstHitmark + 1` = 61f and adds a delayed task at `c.manChaiWalkBack` (100f from the burst, 92f from a Charmed Cloudstrider landing) that, if Gaming is still the active character, resets his skill cooldown and calls `c.c1()`; `cons.go:19-32` heals `Src: 0.15` `HealTypePercent` on Gaming. the heal lands ~161f (2.7s) after the burst press, not at the press — Man Chai spawns at `burstHitmark + 1` = 61f and walks back over `manChaiWalkBack` (gcsim default 100f from the burst, 92f from a plunge, user-tunable via `man_chai_delay`); it RE-FIRES on every Charmed Cloudstrider landing inside the 12s Wushou Stance while Gaming is above 50% HP (`plunge.go:230-234`), and the same link-up also resets his skill cooldown (`burst.go:97`) — neither is authored. ⚠️ Under-claims — one fire per burst modelled against up to three or four in a played 12s stance, which is an omission, not a divergence (no bar shortens, no marker disappears; heal has no planner pixel). ⛔ Do NOT add a second `onHit` `abilityType: 'plunge'` copy for the in-stance repeats: the Wushou Stance is authored as `behavior: "instant"` with no state and no `activeDuration` (see the burst's own note), so there is nothing to gate on and the copy would fire on every cold plunge in the rotation. ⚠️ The link-up also requires Gaming to be the ACTIVE character (`burst.go:94-96`); an `onCast burst` window is on-field by construction, so this is honest for the modelled fire.

constellations.name: To Tame All Beasts
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger on both buff effects — in gcsim, C6 is a permanent attack modifier (AddAttackMod, duration=-1) conditional on atk.Info.Abil == 'Charmed Cloudstrider' (specialPlungeKey). This is an always-on attack-scoped passive, not a triggered buff with duration. The durationType:'fixed' without a duration value is a generator artifact. Also increases specialPlungeRadius from 4 to 6 (not yet in schema). Reviewer to decide schema representation (passive modifier with attack condition, or permanent buff conditional on attack type).

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 To Tame All Beasts — effects[0] (buff critRate 20) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/gaming/cons.go:85-103` — a PERMANENT `AddAttackMod` (`modifier.NewBase(c6Key, -1)`) that returns `CR +0.2 / CD +0.4` only when `atk.Info.Abil == specialPlungeKey` ("Charmed Cloudstrider", `plunge.go:40`); it also raises `specialPlungeRadius` 4 → 6 (`cons.go:87-90`). Retained: the full mechanic: +20% CRIT Rate / +40% CRIT DMG applying ONLY to Charmed Cloudstrider (gcsim's attack-name filter), permanent while C6 is unlocked, plus the attack radius 4 → 6 which has no schema field. Retain the reason it is not authored: the `Stat` union has `critRate` and `critDmg` (all of the recipient's attacks) and the seven `<element>CritDmg` members, and nothing ability- or class-scoped. ⚠️ The only shape that would render is `trigger: 'passive'`, which prints a flat "+20% CRIT Rate" on the always-on chip (`TeamBonusesBlock`) — false for every Gaming normal, charged attack and burst. `pyroCritDmg: 40` would cover the CRIT DMG half at the cost of also buffing his Pyro burst, and there is NO `pyroCritRate` to pair it with, so authoring half of a paired constellation would read as the whole of it. This is the brief's own "+15% CRIT Rate on Charged Attacks only" case.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/rounds/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 To Tame All Beasts — effects[1] (buff critDmg 40) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/gaming/cons.go:92-103` — the same single `AttackMod`; `m[attributes.CR] = 0.2` and `m[attributes.CD] = 0.4` are two entries of one amount slice behind one `atk.Info.Abil != specialPlungeKey` guard. Retained: Covered by the sibling's note — keep ONE note on the C6 entry describing both numbers and the radius change, not two. ⚠️ Same as the sibling. ⚠️ Don't retire one and re-trigger the other: they are one modifier in game, and a chip showing CRIT DMG with no CRIT Rate beside it would misstate the constellation.
